_comment: Optional per-box defaults for claude-bridge. Copy to ~/.claude-bridge/routes.json and edit; every field is optional and falls back to the bridge's own built-in defaults if this file or a field is missing. Model refs use the same dbx:/or:/vendor-model forms as `launch --model`.

profiles._comment: context/max-output token profile per bare model name (no dbx:/or: prefix), used to clamp max_tokens and size CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS. 'default' applies when a model has no specific entry.
